text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Flash-san. Are you in the middle of 
baking sweets?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh—my goodness! What an enormous apple 
pie...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, since we received so many apples, I 
figured I might as well. I was planning to 
share them with everyone later.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Well... in that case, why not invite the 
other girls from our year and have a tea 
party?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I think food tastes much better when 
shared together rather than eaten alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The cup and saucer go over here, and... 
Yeah, this looks good.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, welcome, everyone. Thank you very 
much for coming, despite the sudden 
invitation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Likewise. Thank you for the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, it's merely a whim. I 
was just thinking I'd like a break anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ……Hm? The roses in this vase are――

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... What a beautiful color. It's 
almost as if... it's blazing...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. A fresh, beautiful rose.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (...Fufu, thank goodness...♪)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ho! This mellow, sweet aroma... Milk 
caramel flavor, is it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they've stocked up on fine tea 
leaves.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Well... that is wonderful to hear.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You prefer it sweet, don't you, Ruler-san? 
We have sugar too, so feel free to ask 
anytime.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"This rich aroma... It's a very delicious 
apple pie, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Your skill in baking always amazes me. 
...Thank you, Flash-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm the one who should be thanking 
you. Seeing the smiles on everyone's faces 
as they enjoyed the treats... that means 
the most to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A perfect marriage of apple pie and black 
tea... Hehe, if only there were a board 
game too, it would have been truly 
flawless.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I really should have brought it with me. 
I recently bought an import from Germany. 
It's a heavy game, but with four players, 
the payoff is—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (...Everyone's voices feel so comforting.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Precisely because there is something to 
carry, or perhaps out of pride. A wish to 
surpass those of the same generation—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I truly believe from the bottom of my 
heart that having such a strong spirit is 
noble. ...However—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(This peaceful circle... I want to keep it 
connected forever.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at the time. Having a 
conversation without tactics or mind games 
isn't half bad once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Well... then, if you would like, how about 
joining the next one as well? I shall be 
sure to invite you again—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: No, that won't be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, allow me to host. ...Please 
await an invitation from me."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Huh... Rose-san...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If I only ever receive hospitality, it 
would compromise my honor—and by 
extension, the prestige of my clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Next time, by all means, let me be the 
host.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, they beat me to ittt...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*... Pisa, today I have completely 
fallen prey to your scheme called 
'hospitality'!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this time, it wouldn't be fair 
unless I, as the host, ensnare you in 
return. —Brace yourself, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then it's my turn to invite you next 
time... right? Fufu, I'll make sure to 
prepare plenty of sweets that you like, 
Pisa-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...! Yes, I'll be looking forward 
to... the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪

party. I'm so looking forward to it...♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. Being able to meet everyone as 
peers of the same generation... that is my 
good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I want to keep this 
circle connected. In races, and in 
everyday life!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Fufu, I wonder if everyone is 
chatting? Or maybe playing Ruler-san's 
board game...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Gathering together in a circle, exchanging 
words... I'm sure it will be such a 
blissful moment♪
